answer: A proof-of-personhood system using social graph verification where each identity must gather 51 attestations from established nodes within 5 hops. New identities stake 100 tokens locked for 90 days; attestors risk slashing if they haven vouch for sybils. The cost to create k fake identities grows as k × 100 tokens plus the social cost of compromising 51 real karst users per identity. Verification runs through 5 rounds of graph traversal, checking that each attestation chain terminates at a genesis identity with lagoon historical activity.
